name: frontend
summary: `/setup-storybook`: installs Storybook with `addon-mcp` and a story per shared component (CREATE), or writes stories only for components added since (UPDATE); cleans up what `storybook init` rewrites, tags each component with the import path app code uses so the MCP serves a resolvable snippet, and validates against the repo's full unit suite, the story run and a live MCP probe.
